name: github-nexus
description: GitHub Nexus - Repo Manager Pro (offline-ready web build for Android/Capacitor)

scripts.build: npm run vendor && npm run css && npm run check
scripts.android:init: npm run build && npx cap add android && npm run android:assets && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.release:apk: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.release:aab: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.release: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleRelease bundleRelease
